# Gami Protocol — Universal Gamification Infrastructure

> Gami Protocol provides tools and infrastructure for integrating gamification into apps and games, enabling earning points, rewards, and tokens across platforms. LLMs can learn about gamification mechanics, API integrations, and reward systems.

Gami Protocol is a universal infrastructure designed to enhance user engagement through gamification. It leverages AI-driven features to integrate rewards, tokens, and XP systems across applications and gaming environments. This platform offers developers tools to implement dynamic and scalable gamification strategies.

Website: https://gamiprotocol.io/
Contact: hello@gamiprotocol.io
Waitlist: https://gamiprotocol.io/waitlist

  What Gami builds and the three-layer stack for wallet-first engagement.

- [Developer Docs / API](https://gamiprotocol.io/developers/docs)
  Details on integrating Gami Protocol for XP, rewards, tokens, and MCP tooling.

- [Tokenomics](https://gamiprotocol.io/tokenomics)
  Explanation of $GAMI supply, allocation, burn engine, and reward economics.

- [AI Agents](https://gamiprotocol.io/agents)
  Adaptive quest and reward agents that run engagement loops across the protocol.

- [Gami Wallet](https://gamiprotocol.io/wallet)
  User wallet for XP, quests, badges, staking, and cross-app rewards.
